description: Graduate one of the tenant's WARMED sending sources from 'warming' to 'active', so it can actually send. Until a source is active it is never claimed and every broadcast against it fails with no_sources — this is the step that ends that, and it is the only thing that arms a sending identity for real mail. Admin-level; the tenant comes from your token. ⚠️ IT DOES NOT SKIP THE WARM-UP. A graduated source starts at DAY 1 of its ramp — quote `effective_daily_cap` (what it can send TODAY, normally 8), NEVER `daily_cap` (where the ramp ENDS, normally 50). It also cannot fire for min_gap_seconds after the call. ⚠️ A REFUSAL IS A NORMAL ANSWER, NOT A BUG TO RETRY. 409 warmup_not_matured means the source has not soaked long enough — the message names days served vs days required, and it graduates on its own, so do NOT re-call in a loop. 409 reputation_input_required means the platform has no fresh provider reputation sample, so this source would send with no safety net; only an administrator can waive that. Neither refusal is fixable by the calling agent — report it and stop.

mailbox_id.description: The sending source to graduate. Must already be a source in YOUR pool and in 'warming'. Get it from send_list_sources.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.
